title: Fast participation report ignores the requested date range
reasoning: The command accepts a start/end range and every other metric is computed with that range, but `_compute_user_fast_participation(start_dt, end_dt)` fetches all join and leave events without `timestamp` filters. The generated `user_fast_participation` section can therefore include participation rows wholly outside the requested report period, making date-bounded reports misleading.
recommendation: Filter join and leave events by `timestamp__gte=start_dt` and `timestamp__lte=end_dt`, or clearly separate current lifetime participation from range-bounded metrics if that is the intended contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included, and there is no evidence of assertions that report sections exclude activity outside `--start` and `--end`.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create one join/leave pair before the requested range and one inside it, run the report for the range, and assert `user_fast_participation` contains only the in-range participation.
minimumFixScope: Add date-range filters to the join and leave event queries in `_compute_user_fast_participation` and update any expected report fixtures accordingly.
